basics.name: Ahmed Mazen
basics.label: Enterprise Solution Architect & Technical Team Lead
basics.summary: Enterprise Solution Architect with 21+ years across banking, fintech, telecom, government, education, IoT and enterprise platforms. Combines Java/Jakarta EE and IBM WebSphere, IBM Db2, IBM MQ and FileNet expertise with Oracle Database, Amazon DynamoDB, J2EE/JSF modernisation, cloud and network architecture, microservices, ESB/API integration, event streaming, cybersecurity and resilience. Defines target-state architectures, roadmaps, standards and governance, translating business needs into scalable solutions. Guides cross-functional delivery from discovery and design through implementation, integration, release and operations.

work.name: Synechron
work.summary: Tahakom engagement · Enterprise Java, cloud, platform engineering, cybersecurity and AI
highlights: Lead end-to-end enterprise architecture across Java/Spring, microservices, APIs and modern web applications.
Define application, data, process and infrastructure designs using TOGAF and C4 (L2/L3), including AWS, networking and capacity planning.
Govern architecture, security and the SDLC, guide cross-functional delivery, and integrate AI/ML capabilities for analytics and automation.

work.name: Independent consultant
work.summary: Selected client: IoT platform modernisation, cloud networking, fintech integration and security · UAE and Iraq markets
highlights: Platform modernisation and cloud networking: modernised SpectroTank as AWS cloud-native microservices, defining service connectivity with VPC, VPC Lattice, PrivateLink, NLB/ALB and WAF, with Istio mTLS and SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity.

Fintech billing and payment architecture: designed Stripe Billing and Payments API integrations for usage-based billing, pay-as-you-go pricing, automated payment processing and subscription lifecycle management across UAE and European markets.

Event-driven payment platforms: architected Kafka payment-streaming pipelines using MirrorMaker 2 and Schema Registry for transaction monitoring, fraud detection, anomaly identification and predictive risk scoring.

Enterprise architecture and security governance: applied TOGAF ADM, C4 and PCI DSS 4.0; defined cardholder data environment (CDE) boundaries, policy as code and secrets-management controls using OPA, Kyverno and OpenBao.

Delivery, resilience and observability: established GitOps and CI/CD with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD and Argo Rollouts, with SBOM and vulnerability assessment; designed multi-region disaster recovery, Kubernetes backup and observability using Velero and OpenTelemetry.
Frontend engineering: developed and integrated Angular and React web interfaces for platform workflows, connecting front-end components with cloud-native services and APIs.

work.name: NTG Clarity
highlights: Architected a distributed, multi-tier SNMP network-management and polling platform, defining telemetry collection and aggregation flows to support near-real-time fault detection across carrier networks.

Defined platform availability, scalability and business-continuity standards for services processing millions of network transactions per day, including service-level objectives and resilience requirements.

work.name: NTG Clarity
work.summary: IoT Squared engagement · Enterprise IoT and RTLS platforms
highlights: Architected multi-tenant IoT and real-time location system (RTLS) platforms for Saudi government entities, including SADIA, using ThingsBoard, Spring Boot and Cassandra, with real-time Spark and PostgreSQL analytics.
Led API governance, edge security and full-stack development using Apache APISIX, Alibaba Cloud, React and Node.js to deliver scalable IoT analytics dashboards.

work.name: Independent consultant (selected client: IT-Blocks)
work.summary: Education-sector J2EE/JSF modernisation and IBM enterprise platforms
highlights: Education platform modernisation: modernised a legacy J2EE/JSF educational system, working hands-on with IBM WebSphere Application Server, IBM Db2 and IBM MQ alongside its server-side presentation and Java application layers.
Enterprise application modernisation: focused on maintainability and incremental evolution of the existing platform while preserving established application behaviour and business workflows.

work.name: Raqmiyat
work.summary: ELM engagement · Government integration and national digital services
highlights: Government integration gateways: engineered gateways for Jawazat (General Directorate of Passports) and Mooroor (General Directorate of Traffic; TAMM, Bashir), supporting border-control and travel-authorisation processes, visa services, Saher automated traffic monitoring, vehicle registration and licensing.
Designed backend services and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) workflows for Muqeem and residency-related digital services, supporting visa, Iqama and workforce-management transactions.

Developed mission-critical enterprise integration services connecting national databases through the National Information Center (NIC), enabling secure identity verification and high-concurrency data exchange across government entities.

Full-stack delivery and ways of working: contributed to government application interfaces using Angular and Java/Spring services, collaborating with cross-functional teams through Agile/Scrum practices.
